principles: Block ONLY on provable scope contradictions; degrade everything heuristic to advisory
Pure function, no I/O; reuse the Story-1 overlap engine and a single TERMINAL_PHASES source
Compute the tier-1 literal intersection inside the gate (the hard-block tier) because globsOverlap does not label tiers
Faithful to spec 4.5 (add no new field): fake_dependency_chain stays advise-only without a cited symbol
drivers: globsOverlap does not distinguish tier-1 (block) from tier-2 (advise), so the gate must compute tier-1 itself
StoryInfo.depends is string[] with no cited symbol, so the fake_dependency_chain hard block is not evaluable in-model
The frozen signature plus purity means the caller (Story 5) loads peers/contracts and enforces cfg.mode

options.name: tier1-in-gate-advise-rest
pros: Hard-blocks only on provable tier-1 literal intersection
Reuses Story-1 computeWriteSet/globsOverlap/classifyBroadness with no edits to a DONE story
cons: A small literal set-intersection is computed in the gate (not delegated to globsOverlap)

options.name: extend-globsOverlap-to-label-tiers
pros: One overlap function would return tier info
cons: Requires editing parallel-decomposition-overlap.ts which is Story 1 (out of S2 scope) and re-opens a DONE story

options.name: block-on-any-globsOverlap
cons: Hard-blocks on tier-2 shared-prefix over-flags, violating the provable-only invariant (DoS on legitimate parallel stories)

rationale: Provable-only blocking is the spec invariant; globsOverlap cannot be the block oracle because it mixes tier-1 and tier-2, and editing the Story-1 engine is out of scope; computing a cheap literal exact-path set-intersection in the gate is the minimal correct path, with globsOverlap reused for the tier-2 advisory and classifyBroadness for broadness.

preMortem.scenario: False hard block on a tier-2 shared-prefix overlap
preMortem.trigger: using globsOverlap.overlap directly for the block
preMortem.consequence: legitimate parallel stories blocked from DEV (a DoS)
preMortem.mitigation: the block uses ONLY a literal exact-path set-intersection (tier-1); tier-2 pairs from globsOverlap are emitted as advisories; the smoke asserts a tier-2-only case returns block=null plus an advisory

preMortem.scenario: Broad-glob block fires under the wrong profile
preMortem.consequence: light/balanced profiles wrongly block legitimate broad contracts
preMortem.mitigation: broad maps to block ONLY when cfg.broadGlobBlocks is true, else an advisory; the smoke asserts both broadGlobBlocks true and false

preMortem.trigger: inventing a symbol-absent check with no cited-symbol input
preMortem.consequence: a false hard block on a legitimate depends edge
preMortem.mitigation: with depends string[] and no symbol the falsifiable case is not evaluable, so the gate never hard-blocks fake_dependency_chain in-model (advise-only), documented per spec 4.5; the smoke asserts a depends edge does NOT produce this block

preMortem.scenario: terminalPhases drift between gate and policy
preMortem.trigger: re-defining the DONE/DISCARDED set locally in the gate
preMortem.consequence: the gate and parallel-policy disagree on which peers are active
preMortem.mitigation: hoist and export TERMINAL_PHASES from parallel-policy.ts and import it in the gate (single source); parallel-policy keeps using the same const

preMortem.trigger: reading cfg.mode to abort inside the gate
preMortem.consequence: violates purity/separation; Story 5 double-enforces or diverges from the message
preMortem.mitigation: the gate returns block plus advisories only and never reads cfg.mode (only cfg.broadGlobBlocks); the caller decides; smoke and review confirm no cfg.mode reference
